name: Support Ticket
description: Answer Once support request with AI-first escalation and knowledge-loop metadata

name: Knowledge Article
description: Organizational knowledge learned from resolved support interactions

name: Ticket Thread
description: Conversation thread attached to an Answer Once support ticket

name: Ticket Message
description: Message on an Answer Once support ticket thread

name: Shared Knowledge Article
description: Published learning shared with all customer accounts — lives in the platform corpus

name: Change Marker
description: An intentional operational change or consequential event annotated on Reporting trends

name: Triage Directive
description: Admin-authored routing rule for Answer Once triage. Semantic intent match (match_description embeddings) lets the triage agent select a directive via apply_directive; the runtime executes its structured actions — record ops, reply template, pipelines — deterministically. Never writable by customers.

name: Directive Subscription
description: Tenant opt-in that authorizes a platform-authored triage directive to execute gated actions (auto_reply, set_fields, escalate, pipelines) in this account. apply_directive checks for an active subscription with sufficient max_tier whenever a platform directive's required tier exceeds 'annotate'. Written via admin-data — never customer-writable.
